perModule.notes: Feature-rich and thoughtfully engineered module (snapshots, blocker prediction, CSV backup, staged deprecation) but it predates the shared affordances: sftkFriendlyError is never called (11 raw-error surfaces, several crammed into button labels), sftkCat appears only twice, and most destructive one-click actions (flow-version purge, FLS strip, restore-as-Active) ship with zero confirmation while the one well-confirmed action (field delete) overstates its own irreversibility.

bareLoadingStates.fix: Shell renders a bare 'Loading…' in the count span while the list placeholder next to it already shows sftkCatSm; set it empty (or '—') until _loadLogs resolves so there aren't two competing loading texts.
User-search dropdown shows bare 'Searching…' during the SOQL await — use sftkCatSm('Searching users…') inside the drop message div.

_startTrace runs up to 4 sequential API calls (DebugLevel query/create, TraceFlag query, PATCH/POST) with only button text as feedback; render sftkCatSm('Starting trace…') into #adbgStatusCell for the duration.

_stopTrace awaits the TraceFlag delete with no visual state at all — the ⏹ Stop button stays enabled and unchanged until the call returns. Disable it and show 'Stopping…' (or sftkCatSm in the status cell) during the await.

_purgeOld deletes logs one-by-one (SF_QUERY_ALL can return far more than the 200 listed) with only 'Purging…' on the button and no list repaint until done; put sftkCatSm in #adbgLogList plus a live 'Deleting n/N' counter in #adbgLogCount.
_deleteSelected loops sequential deletes with only static button text; show sftkCatSm placeholder or a 'Deleting n/N' progress in #adbgLogCount as each _bg call completes.
_deleteAll can issue up to 200 sequential delete calls (easily 30+ seconds) with no progress indicator; replace the list body with sftkCatSm('Deleting logs…') and update a n/N counter per completion.

_openLogInNewTab may refetch a multi-MB log body and write it to chrome.storage with only '… opening' on the button; swap the detail-panel header area to sftkCatSm('Preparing log viewer…') while it works.

rawErrorSurfaces.fix: User-search dropdown prints the raw SOQL/session error verbatim; pass res.error through sftkFriendlyError() and render {message} with {hint} as a sub-line.

_startTrace catch surfaces raw Tooling API errors (e.g. FIELD_INTEGRITY_EXCEPTION JSON from TraceFlag create, 'Could not create DebugLevel: <raw>' from line 692) in the status pill; run err.message through sftkFriendlyError() before rendering.

_loadLogs failure shows the raw query error in the list placeholder; translate via sftkFriendlyError() (session-expired and missing-Tooling-permission are the common cases here and both have known friendly forms).
_openLog body-fetch failure prints the raw REST error (often a 404 NOT_FOUND JSON when the log was auto-purged); use sftkFriendlyError() and add a 'log may have been deleted — refresh the list' hint.
_downloadRaw uses a native alert() with the raw error — double miss: route through sftkFriendlyError() and show via showModal (or an inline detail-panel error) instead of alert.

perModule.notes: Strong module overall — sftkCat/sftkCatSm used at the 4 big repaints (list load, parse, compare) and Delete All/Purge use two-click arming, but sftkFriendlyError is never used (6 raw error surfaces incl. two native alert()s), single-log and Delete Selected have zero confirmation for permanent deletes, and bulk deletes give no n/N progress.

perModule.notes: Solid module overall — escHtml used on all dynamic tree strings, run-token guard prevents stale cross-org scans, and its only destructive affordance correctly defers to the Flows tab modal; the two real gaps are the silent scan path for sub-threshold orgs and an all-silent error policy (line 84-85 empty catch, line 62 skips result.error) that makes a totally failed scan (e.g. expired session) indistinguishable from the genuine 'No subflow relationships found' empty state at line 323.
